name: skills
description: Drive paid AI subscriptions as external agents: Codex/Grok/Antigravity CLIs as bounded consultants, and ChatGPT/Grok deep research through a logged-in browser. No API keys.

interface.shortDescription: Subscription-driven external agents and deep research
interface.longDescription: Two skills. harness-coding-agents runs the Codex, Grok, and Antigravity CLIs as bounded read-only consultants or explicitly authorised implementers, with a preflight for binaries and logins. deep-research runs a prompt through a logged-in ChatGPT Pro or SuperGrok session in a real Chrome, inside a dedicated project, and captures the report into an intake file.
defaultPrompt: Get a second opinion from codex and grok on this diff.
Run a deep research on this topic and capture the report.
